captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a vintage casino slot machine cabinet. The main body consists of a tall, dark gray central column flanked by red side panels, resting on a black base block. On the right side, there is a yellow rectangular mounting plate holding a black angled pull handle with a cylindrical grip. A gray rectangular coin tray projects forward from the bottom front face of the machine.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a casino slot machine with a tall dark cabinet, red side panels, a gray coin tray at the base, and a rotatable black pull handle mounted on a yellow plate on the right side.
captions.factory: The slot machine is constructed by first building the base and main cabinet column using Box primitives. The red side panels are created as separate thin box shapes positioned on either side of the column. The coin tray is formed by subtracting a smaller box from a larger one to create a hollowed tray at the bottom front. The handle mechanism is built from a yellow box base, a small cylinder joint, an angled cylinder lever arm, and a horizontal cylinder handle grip, all assembled as parts with appropriate materials.
